judged_text: `{{#unless automatic}}` in the group-member item view template resolves `automatic` against the item view's context — the member (a Discourse.User), which has no `automatic` property — instead of the group the surrounding group.hbs template binds. The remove control renders on every member row of automatic groups (admins, moderators, trust_level_*), where the server forbids removal — clicking it shows a bootbox confirm and then always fails with an error response, presenting an action the system cannot perform.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs` the remove link is gated by `{{#unless automatic}}`, but this template is rendered as an `itemView` via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` in `admin/templates/group.hbs`. An item view’s template resolves bare properties like `automatic` against the item-view context (the member/Discourse.User or the item view), not the surrounding group controller/model; since the member has no `automatic` flag, `automatic` is falsy and the `unless` block will render. That exposes a “remove” control for automatic groups, while the server explicitly forbids membership changes for automatic groups (`Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`/`#add_members` return `can_not_modify_automatic`).
